additive_replacements.asymptotic_caveat: O(S+R) has an unspecified constant, so one finite example cannot refute that notation by itself. These are explicit violations for the listed constants, plus checked exact counts for a parameterized exponential-unfolding family; the parent supplies the general argument.
additive_replacements.semantic_caveat: Every chain computes x. A formula consisting of the input alone has zero gates and one literal. This is exponential SYNTACTIC unfolding, never an intrinsic formula-size lower bound.

caveat: Expected counterexamples to the tempting additive and universal contraction claims are stored in their own sections, not mislabeled as failures of the tested sharing upper bounds. The parent handles general proofs.

model.arithmetic: Python integers and fractions.Fraction; rationals serialized as numerator/denominator strings.
model.basis: Single-output topological DAG; AND/OR fanin 2, NOT fanin 1; input/constant sources fanin 0.
model.exhaustive_scope: All topologically ordered descriptions through the configured gate limit over two inputs x,y and constant sources 0,1, with all output choices. Not all circuits.
model.fanout: Source-to-consumer wire count in the reachable subgraph only. No virtual output wire. R uses internal gates only; reused inputs and constants are excluded.
model.leaves: leaf_count includes constants; literal_leaf_count counts variable occurrences. NOT stays an explicit gate. Both satisfy the tested 1+S*2^R bound.
model.path_direction: Output-to-operand paths. The root has one zero-length path. Unreachable nodes have zero paths. The product bound on path counts is for INTERNAL nodes only, not reused input leaves.
model.product: P=product_internal max(1,outdegree). Finite checks test internal path counts<=P, P<=2^R, unfolded gates<=S*P<=S*2^R.
model.size: S counts reachable AND/OR/NOT gates once; declared_S also reports unused gates. Constants are leaves, not gates.
model.unfolding: Copy every wire recursively with no Boolean simplification. DP sizes, path sums, and budgeted explicit trees independently agree.
model.wire_multiplicity: Ordered operand slots are separate wires, including AND(v,v) or OR(v,v). Structurally identical gate nodes are not silently merged.

naive_gate_sqrt_additive_contraction.expectation_method: For M~Binomial(N,p), E SIZE >= E[max(M-1,0)] >= E[M]-1 = Np-1. No 3^256 enumeration.
naive_gate_sqrt_additive_contraction.general_argument_deferred: The fixed-small-p, large-N argument for arbitrary fixed A,B, using sqrt(S)=o(N), is left to the parent/peer; no generic refutation is claimed from this finite check.
naive_gate_sqrt_additive_contraction.scope: Finite obstruction to this naive GATE-size analogue at A=B=1 only. The pure p^2 control remains separate. This does not refute the formula-leaf bound using L or establish a promise-correct GapMCSP solver consequence.
naive_gate_sqrt_additive_contraction.unfolding_caveat: No intrinsic formula lower bound is inferred from syntactic DAG unfolding.

clean_instance.interpretation: The residual binary-gate lower bound also lower-bounds total gates. The source is an explicit size upper bound; a smaller optimal source only decreases p^2*S.
clean_instance.not_claimed: No promise-correct GapMCSP solver consequence, no intrinsic unfolding lower bound, and no refutation of every additive-term or unspecified-constant variant.

universal_quadratic_gate_contraction.formula_comparison_caveat: This p^2-only control is not the audited formula bound, which also has p*sqrt(L); the naive gate analogue with a square-root additive term is tested separately.
universal_quadratic_gate_contraction.lower_bound_used: A fanin-two circuit with m essential inputs needs at least max(m-1,0) binary gates; NOT gates do not merge dependencies. This elementary structural fact is the semantic lower bound, not an exhaustive search over all competing circuits.

requested_instance.interpretation: The residual binary-gate lower bound also lower-bounds total gates. The source is an explicit size upper bound; a smaller optimal source only decreases p^2*S.
requested_instance.not_claimed: No promise-correct GapMCSP solver consequence, no intrinsic unfolding lower bound, and no refutation of every additive-term or unspecified-constant variant.

universal_quadratic_gate_contraction.scope: Obstruction to the stated universal coefficient-one pure p^2 GATE-size contraction; not a promise-correct GapMCSP algorithm result, not a formal general proof, and not a rejection of all additive-term or arbitrary-constant variants.
